title: Freestanding Coat Rack 60-Inch Brass Assorted Free Standing Accessorie For Bathroom Storage | Antique Copper | Allied Brass
description:
Add organized, no-drill storage to your bathroom with this freestanding coat rack made from brass with pivoting pegs in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style bathrooms. The weighted base helps keep the rack stable to resist tipping, and the felt pad helps prevent scratching on hard surfaces. A strong choice for traditional bathroom hardware setups, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures where you want a standing rack instead of wall-mounted hooks.

Highlights:
- Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Pivoting pegs for hanging robes, towels, coats, and accessories
- Weighted base to help prevent tipping
- Felt pad to help protect floors

Specs:
- Dimensions: 60-Inch height; 10-Inch width; 10-Inch length
- Weight capacity: 18 lb
- Product weight: 14.4 lb
- Assembly required: Yes
- Included item: Freestanding coat rack

Offered in multiple designer finish options, including statement colors.
